content.comment_body: Hello, I've recently tried to implement this application example: [url] I followed the instructions given in the manual, except that I tested the example with one [product_name] instead of two. My experience with the [product_name] web editor is limited, but I was able to get the motor running as intended. However, when using the custom web page to operate the [product_name], the updates are not truly in real time. I have to manually refresh the page to see the latest Status and Control word states for the [product_name]. Sometimes, even after multiple refreshes, the page doesn't update, making it impossible to determine the current state and operate the motor reliably. Could someone advise what may be causing this issue? I even added the displayed time from [product_name] to the web page to check if it was online, but the time itself updates inconsistently. Thanks!

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing unreliable and delayed feedback while operating a [product_name] motor via a custom web interface created with [product_name] Web Editor and a communication module. Status and control words do not update in real time, and manual page refreshes often fail to show the current state, leading to uncertainty in motor control. Online connectivity indicators, like embedded time, are inconsistent, further contributing to confusion regarding system status.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the control and status information on the web page to update reliably and in real time, allowing for accurate monitoring and straightforward operation of the motor. They want the web interface to provide seamless feedback, without the need for manual refreshes, and for connectivity indicators to consistently show the actual system state.
